title: Syntax, Artha, Statements ani Expressions
learningObjectives: Syntax mhunnlear code borovpache niyam samzai.
Syntax niyam kityak gorjeche te sang.
JavaScript-ant bracket ani chinhanchi chuk olkhoi.
Syntax ani logic error-cho farak sang.
Statement mhaka puro adesh mhunn olkhoi.
Expression mhaka value divpi code-cho vibhag mhunn olkhoi.
Declaration, assignment ani function call olkhoi.
Kimot ani sankhya vaprun total-chem udaharan di.
Variables, operators, conditions, loops ani functions shikpak he adhar vapर.

understand.concept: Programming bhashen code borovpak nem asतात. Hya nemank Syntax mhunnat. Semantics mhunnlear barobar code-cho artha ani to chalu zalyar to kite karta. Statement mhunnlear puro adesh. Expression mhunnlear evaluate kelyar Value mellpi code-cho vibhag.
understand.whyItMatters: Syntax code koso borovcho te sangta; Semantics code kite karta te sangta; Statement adesh dakhoyta ani Expression Value purayta.
understand.history: এই পাঠে বিভিন্ন ভাষার সাধারণ নিয়ম শেখানো হয়।
understand.analogy: Manxachi bhashechem grammar Syntax sarkem ani vakyacho artha Semantics sarko. Recipe-cho puro paulo Statement ani bhitorli ganit Expression sarki.
understand.analogyLimit: Programming bhashe niyam paltat. He fakt samzovpak udaharan.

explain.narrative: Syntax code koso borovcho te tharoyta. JavaScript-ant let, const, operators ani brackets-ache nem asतात. Chinh vo bracket sodlyar Syntax Error yevpak shakta. Syntax barobar asun chukichi kriya vaparlyar Logic Error zata. const total = 2 + 3; hi declaration Statement ani 2 + 3 hi Expression; tiche mol 5.

examples.explanation: 2 + 3 Expression-chem mol 5. Puro declaration Statement ani ganit Expression.
2 + 3 Expression-chem mol 5. Puro declaration Statement ani ganit Expression.

practise.guidedTask: price 120 ani quantity 2 aslo udaharan ghe. Statements ani Expressions olkhoi; total 240 kadd.
practise.independentTask: Kimot, sankhya ani total dakhoypi JavaScript udaharan boroi. Statements ani Expressions olkhoi. Ek Syntax chuk ani ek Logic chuk sang.
hints: Code-chem ganit barobar asa kai te tapas.

questions.prompt: Syntax barobar asun chukichi kriya vaparlyar?
